CITY OF SANTA CLAUS Business License Rates - 2023

Any new business desiring to open and do business within the corporate limits of the City of Santa Claus must comply with the following stipulations set forth by this Council and Mayor:

- 1. Must purchase a business license of the correct classification from the City of Santa Claus prior to the opening of said business.

- 2. Have this business license displayed where it can be observed on or after opening for business.

Any existing business will continue to have until December 31 of the year at hand to renew their business license.

Be it further ordained by the Mayor and Council that any person engaging or attempting to engage in any of the kinds of business as will appear by reference to said schedule hereto attached, and for which a specific tax is required after the first of January, 2023, without having obtained a license for the purpose of so engaging, shall be penalized twenty-five (25%) percent of the amount of the said specific tax and on conviction of having operated or engaged in any kind of business hereto referred, without having obtained a license to carry on such business in said City, shall be fined in the sum of not to exceed one hundred ($100.00) dollars, and the cost of said prosecution, or sentenced to imprisonment as provided in the laws of said City, not to exceed sixty (60) days, either or both, in the discretion of the Council.

Be it further ordained by the Mayor and Council that all ordinances in conflict with this ordinance are and the same is hereby repealed and becomes effective on the first day of January, 2023.

Adopted by unanimous consent of the Council on the first reading, all members being present and ordered posted at the City Hall, and the City website.
